comparison.scope: Initial native parity policy uses the upstream testing defaults for each captured dtype, including every composed latent and final floating-point pixel tensor. Token IDs, masks, schedules, fixed inputs and CPU-seeded noise require exact equality. These thresholds are independent declarations, not measured MOSS quality limits or evidence of native agreement. Native mismatches do not authorize wider tolerances. Backend comparisons are diagnostic and cannot substitute for matched-reference acceptance. Held-out image quality and resource budgets remain separate obligations.

host_audit.scope: Host provenance only; installed capacity is not an execution budget. GPU identity and CUDA version are embedded in each CUDA reference. Full-image references bind the upstream automatic SDPA policy through the producer; exact dispatched operator names were captured only for the paired small-canvas CUDA cases.
host_audit.source: Win32_Processor and Win32_OperatingSystem queried on the same local oracle host after capture
